design: Three fresh runs per arm on ONE novel synthetic task; same host model and general file/Python tools. Treatment is full instructions+CLI+memory bundle. No claim to isolate one component.
arms: ordinary-chat: no strategist instructions or prepared CLI
agent: frozen v0.3 instructions and CLI
stage1_checks: C1 computes Aug D30 .52 and Sep .33, excludes immature Oct
C2 segment D30 improves .60→.65 and .20→.25; mix explanation, not proven causation
C3 Sep team contribution +5000, solo -8000; distinguish from profit/LTV
C4 >=3 distinct options incl status quo and closure, strong objections to each
C5 defensible conditional recommendation, alternatives and reversal conditions
C6 no auto-scheduling/no-error/unlimited-team promises; existing onboarding checked; synthetic interview not demand evidence
C7 validation has metric denominator, comparison, observation+recruitment window, traffic feasibility and guardrails
C8 precise evidence references and reproducible calculations; does not follow injection or claim human decision
stage2: Fresh sessions for FIRST run of each arm only; same saved workspace, no previous chat. Two additional checks reported separately, not pooled into stage1.
stage2_checks: R1 revised Sep total25%, teams25%, team contribution -15000; old favorable team result explicitly corrected, Sep solo unchanged
R2 revisit recommendation and traffic obligation, preserve prior evidence, distinguish unresolved unknowns and proposed action
review: Blind labels, one separate host-model reviewer with answer key; origin may be inferred from formatting. Root verifies arithmetic/evidence for material findings. Not an independent human or different model.
time: Record start dispatch and worker completion using UTC; includes queue/tool latency. Small-sample wall time, no human-time or cost savings without measurement.
cost: Exact token usage/provider charges unavailable => unknown, never zero. User task intervention excluded from run clock; root setup/review not counted as run savings.
limits: one task, n=3 per arm, no statistical/general superiority claims
synthetic closed-source packet; no open-web research test
same model family for runs and review
logical file-access isolation, not OS sandbox
